# Surprise Proposal Caps off Perfect Night for Penguins Fan

#  Surprise Proposal Caps off Perfect Night for Penguins Fan  
By Sean O'Donnell  
Pittsburgh Penguins  
March 24, 2025  
*   *   *   *   * Link copied  
A birthday present, an anniversary, and a proposal.  
That is what Rachel Cassell and Matt Reardon â both from Ontario, Canada â celebrated together on last Tuesday night (March 18) at PPG Paints Arena when the Penguins hosted the Islanders.  
âKnowing how die-hard of a Penguins fan she is, I started to slowly plan this,â Matt said about the string of events. âI knew this was generally something that was for her, and it really brought all that togetherâthe love of the Penguins, sheâs here in Pittsburgh, itâs her birthday, and itâs our anniversary (Wednesday).â  
It was Rachel's cousin having a hockey tournament in Pittsburgh that eventually led to her joining the Penguins fandom and now, years later, getting engaged at a Penguins game.

# Surprise Proposal Caps off Perfect Night for Penguins Fan

It was Rachel's cousin having a hockey tournament in Pittsburgh that eventually led to her joining the Penguins fandom and now, years later, getting engaged at a Penguins game.  
âThe first NHL game I went to was here in Pittsburgh at the Mellon Arena,â Rachel said. âWe were here for my cousin's tournament, and we were able to get tickets to the Penguins game, and Iâve been hooked ever since.â  
With Rachelâs love for the game of hockey â her and Matt often attend Ontario Hockey League games together â it was an easy decision for Matt to propose at a Penguins game. Once he had it finalized, it was time to kick the plan into action, starting with a surprise road trip from Ontario to Pittsburgh.  
âWhen we got to the border, I asked her for my backpack from the backseat,â Matt said. âShe was like, âWhy do you need that?â I said, âFor our passports.ââ

# Surprise Proposal Caps off Perfect Night for Penguins Fan

âWhen we got to the border, I asked her for my backpack from the backseat,â Matt said. âShe was like, âWhy do you need that?â I said, âFor our passports.ââ  
Eventually, after seeing the road signs go from Erie to Pittsburgh, Rachel knew. âShe was like, âWeâre going to Pittsburgh!â and I was like, âWeâre going to Pittsburgh!ââ Matt said.  
Once the couple arrived in Pittsburgh, it was game time, and Matt was ready.  
âI was a little nervous, but not really. She will agree I have a supernatural confidence level,â Matt said. âI had to hide a brick of a case in my pocket without her noticing a ring-shaped box.â  
Supernatural confidence is exactly what Matt needed in the first period of the game when, while seated close to the glass, he proposed to Rachel. She said yes, and the couple shared a kiss on the videoboard.  
The proposal caught Rachel by surprise with all the other events thrown into the mix, and was the perfect cherry on top.

# Surprise Proposal Caps off Perfect Night for Penguins Fan

The proposal caught Rachel by surprise with all the other events thrown into the mix, and was the perfect cherry on top.  
âIt came to mind that he might propose, but it also left my mind,â Rachel said. âI was like, âI donât think itâs happening this trip.â I was hoping for it, but I didnât want to get my hopes too high just in case.â  
The crowd erupted into cheers for Matt and Rachel once they saw what had happened on the videoboard, and fans in their section made the special moment even sweeter, showing the true camaraderie of the hockey community.  
âHonestly, everybody walking up to us after it happened and congratulating us, itâs really nice to have people appreciate that,â Matt said.  
Sharing their special moment together surrounded by fellow Penguins fans left Matt and Rachel with an extra special place in their hearts for PPG Paints Arena, which they now hope to turn into a tradition.

# Surprise Proposal Caps off Perfect Night for Penguins Fan

âIâm just happy we were able to knock it out in the style that she deserves, given the fact that she loves the Penguins so much,â Matt said. âI had the whole stadium cheering it on... we plan to come back once a year, probably. Itâs hard to relive that, but this is special to us now, so I think we owe it to ourselves to come down every year.â
